findings.finding: The original paid callback returns the response only after receipt assembly. An exception between response return and complete callback return leaves guard observed=None, so a response may be lost while its reservation is correctly retained.

Old transport catches exclude HTTPException/IncompleteRead. Repair03 catches exceptions within _post_exact but that wrapper alone does not diagnose errors in hooks, receipt assembly, guard validation or ledger completion. Do not claim complete callback diagnostics.

Initial repair03 transport-loss adapter entered the old invalid-response branch. Current candidate rewrites the exact mechanical continuation label to unavailable and projects a typed transport_slot_loss event with null actual cost, no fake assistant message, and preserved reservation.

Current resume writes its one-time claim before constructing/preflighting the backend. A free preflight failure could permanently consume resumption without a new POST. Preflight should succeed before claim creation, followed by exact-prefix revalidation.

Existing Engine and current repair03 refuse claimed-stage restart even when an exact backend stage_result may have been saved before Engine._commit. This is a safe stop, not generic restart recovery. Allow only verified complete-stage cache commit with zero POST or disclose the limit.
